scope: exhaustive independent interval annotation of the historical audit cohort
independence: Reviewers annotate separately, with no original-author labels, confidence values or detector proposals in this repository. Prior familiarity with the data is acknowledged.
practice: Separate synthetic traces for tool familiarization; never included in the evaluation export.
reference_policy: Preserve each reviewer export separately; no automatic adjudication or merging.
data_scope: Audit cohort only; no new tuning set is included.
analysis_status: This fixes collection and visualization, not comparator tuning or agreement-analysis settings. No detector run is authorized by this package.
versioning: Any change to instructions, display, event semantics or defaults requires a new release and an explicit decision about repeating affected reviews.
delivery: Private repository, named collaborators only. Return final JSON directly to the coordinator; never commit or attach annotations to a shared issue or pull request.
identity: Automatic anonymous local session; associate a named reviewer only upon receipt.
input_gestures: Two boundary clicks in either order, or a drag, on raw overview or filtered signal. Integer coordinates on original signal. Event save and trace completion have separate buttons.
